ESTADO.SEM_ACESSO_TEXTO: Your role is not allowed to see this.
ESTADO.LIMITE: Too many refreshes in a row. Wait a minute.

KM_MENSAL.SUBTITULO: Last 90 days. The first month may be incomplete.
KM_MENSAL.VAZIO: No completed trips in the last 90 days.
KM_MENSAL.RESUMO: Line chart of km driven per month. {{lista}}.

STATUS.RESUMO: Donut chart of vehicles by status. {{lista}}.

SEVERIDADE.RESUMO: Bar chart of incidents by severity. {{lista}}.

TABELA.SUBTITULO_GESTAO: The 5 most recent trips in the fleet.

PAGINAS.EM_CONSTRUCAO_TEXTO: This screen will be delivered in the next project phases.

ERROS_API.SEM_PERMISSAO: You do not have permission for this action.
ERROS_API.SEM_CONEXAO: No connection to the server. Check your internet.
ERROS_API.SERVICO_EXTERNO: Postal code lookup service unavailable, try again.
ERROS_API.CREDENCIAIS: Password or API key do not match.
ERROS_API.LIMITE: Too many attempts in a row. Wait a minute and try again.

CABECALHO.NOTIFICACOES_VAZIO_TEXTO: When there are fleet alerts, they will show up here.

COMUM.VAZIO: There are no deleted records to restore.

ERROS_CAMPO.INTEIRO: Use whole numbers only, no decimals.

ERROS_NEGOCIO.VEICULO_EM_USO: The vehicle is already in use on another trip.
ERROS_NEGOCIO.VEICULO_EM_MANUTENCAO: The vehicle is under maintenance and cannot be used.
ERROS_NEGOCIO.VEICULO_FORA_SERVICO: The vehicle is out of service.
ERROS_NEGOCIO.VEICULO_INDISPONIVEL: The vehicle is not available (in use, under maintenance or out of service).
ERROS_NEGOCIO.VEICULO_COM_VIAGEM: The vehicle has an active trip. Finish or cancel the trip first.
ERROS_NEGOCIO.VEICULO_EM_USO_EXCLUIR: This vehicle is in use and cannot be deleted right now.
ERROS_NEGOCIO.CNH_VENCIDA: The driver license is expired. Update the record before creating the trip.
ERROS_NEGOCIO.MOTORISTA_COM_VIAGEM: The driver already has an active trip.
ERROS_NEGOCIO.VIAGEM_NAO_PLANEJADA: The trip is no longer planned. The screen was refreshed.
ERROS_NEGOCIO.VIAGEM_NAO_EM_ANDAMENTO: The trip is no longer in progress. The screen was refreshed.
ERROS_NEGOCIO.VIAGEM_NAO_CANCELAVEL: This trip is already completed or cancelled and cannot be cancelled.
ERROS_NEGOCIO.VIAGEM_ATIVA_EXCLUIR: An active trip cannot be deleted. Cancel the trip first.
ERROS_NEGOCIO.KM_FINAL_MENOR_INICIAL: The final KM cannot be lower than the trip start KM.
ERROS_NEGOCIO.KM_FINAL_MENOR_VEICULO: The final KM cannot be lower than the vehicle current KM.
ERROS_NEGOCIO.KM_INICIAL_MENOR_VEICULO: The start KM cannot be lower than the vehicle current KM.
ERROS_NEGOCIO.KM_ATUAL_MENOR: The KM cannot be lower than the start KM or the vehicle current KM.
ERROS_NEGOCIO.KM_NAO_PODE_DIMINUIR: The vehicle current KM cannot decrease.
ERROS_NEGOCIO.STATUS_EM_USO_SO_VIAGEM: The "In use" status only changes through trips.
ERROS_NEGOCIO.PLACA_JA_CADASTRADA: A vehicle with this plate already exists.
ERROS_NEGOCIO.CNH_JA_CADASTRADA: This license number is already registered for another driver.
ERROS_NEGOCIO.USUARIO_JA_MOTORISTA: This user is already a driver.
ERROS_NEGOCIO.USUARIO_NAO_EXISTE: The selected user no longer exists.
ERROS_NEGOCIO.VALIDADE_NO_PASSADO: The license expiry date cannot be in the past.
ERROS_NEGOCIO.PLACA_FORMATO: Use the Mercosul plate format (ABC1D23) or the old one (ABC1234).
ERROS_NEGOCIO.VIACEP_INDISPONIVEL: Postal code lookup service unavailable, try again.
ERROS_NEGOCIO.MANUTENCAO_CONCLUIR_ANTES: The completion date cannot be before the scheduled date. Complete it from the scheduled date on.
ERROS_NEGOCIO.INCIDENTE_STATUS_SO_AVANCA: The incident status only moves forward: reported, under investigation, resolved.
ERROS_NEGOCIO.REGISTRO_REFERENCIADO: This record is used by other records and cannot be permanently deleted.
ERROS_NEGOCIO.FOTO_TIPO: File type not accepted. Send JPEG, PNG or PDF.
ERROS_NEGOCIO.FOTO_RECUSADA: The API refused the file. Check the type (JPEG, PNG or PDF) and the size (up to 10 MB).
ERROS_NEGOCIO.ADMIN_SO_ADMIN_MODIFICA: Only an administrator can change another administrator account.
ERROS_NEGOCIO.NAO_DESATIVAR_PROPRIA_CONTA: You cannot deactivate or delete your own account.
ERROS_NEGOCIO.ADMIN_NAO_DESATIVA: An administrator account cannot be deactivated or deleted.
ERROS_NEGOCIO.NAO_MUDAR_PROPRIO_PAPEL: Nobody can change their own role.
ERROS_NEGOCIO.ADMIN_NAO_REBAIXA_NEM_PROMOVE: This account is already an administrator, the highest role. There is nowhere to promote to.
ERROS_NEGOCIO.USUARIO_JA_TEM_PAPEL: The user already has this role.
ERROS_NEGOCIO.PAPEL_SO_SOBE: A role can only go up. Demoting is not possible.
ERROS_NEGOCIO.EMAIL_JA_CADASTRADO: A user with this e-mail already exists.
ERROS_NEGOCIO.EMAIL_OU_CNH_JA_CADASTRADOS: This e-mail or this license number is already registered.

VEICULOS.SUBTITULO: Plate, status and mileage of each fleet vehicle.
VEICULOS.SUBTITULO_EXCLUIDOS: Vehicles removed from the fleet (inactive). Restore one to show it again.
VEICULOS.NOTA_FILTROS: Plate, model and year filter only the {{quantidade}} vehicles on this page. Status filters the whole fleet.
VEICULOS.VAZIO_TEXTO: Register the first vehicle to start organizing the fleet.
VEICULOS.SEM_RESULTADO: No vehicle on this page matches the filters.
VEICULOS.EXCLUIR_TEXTO: Vehicle {{placa}} ({{modelo}}) leaves the fleet list. You can restore it later in the "Removed" tab.
VEICULOS.AJUDA_PLACA: Mercosul (ABC1D23) or old (ABC1234). Lowercase becomes uppercase.
VEICULOS.AJUDA_PLACA_FIXA: The plate does not change after registration.
VEICULOS.AJUDA_STATUS_EM_USO: The vehicle is in use: the status changes by itself when the trip ends.
VEICULOS.ERRO_PLACA: Invalid plate. Use ABC1D23 (Mercosul) or ABC1234 (old).

MOTORISTAS.SUBTITULO: License number, expiry and status of each driver.
MOTORISTAS.RESUMO_VENCIDAS: {{quantidade}} active driver(s) with an expired license.
MOTORISTAS.RESUMO_VENCENDO: {{quantidade}} with a license expiring within 30 days.
MOTORISTAS.VAZIO_TEXTO: Drivers are created together with the user (Driver role, with license), in New user.
MOTORISTAS.EXCLUIR_TEXTO: {{nome}} stops showing in the driver list. Anyone with restore permission can bring it back in the "Removed" tab.
MOTORISTAS.AVISO_VENCIDA_TEXTO: This driver cannot be assigned to trips until the license is renewed.
MOTORISTAS.AVISO_VENCENDO_TEXTO: Ask for a renewal to avoid interrupting trips.

VIAGENS.SUBTITULO: Follow planned, in-progress and finished trips.
VIAGENS.VAZIO_TEXTO: When there are trips for the chosen filters, they appear here.
VIAGENS.KM_PENDENTE: KM is calculated when the trip ends
VIAGENS.SUBTITULO_NOVA: Choose the driver and the vehicle and enter the departure and arrival postal codes. The km is recorded when the trip starts and ends.
VIAGENS.AJUDA_MOTORISTA: Only active drivers with a valid license appear.
VIAGENS.AJUDA_MOTORISTA_PROPRIO: The trip will be created in your name.
VIAGENS.AJUDA_SEM_MOTORISTA: No active driver with a valid license. Register or renew a license.
VIAGENS.AJUDA_SEM_VEICULO: No vehicle available right now. Come back when a trip ends.
VIAGENS.AJUDA_CEP: We validate the ZIP code with ViaCEP and store the city and state.
VIAGENS.ERRO_CEP: Enter a ZIP code with 8 digits, like 01310-100.
VIAGENS.ERRO_CEP_API: Invalid or unknown postal code. Check the number and try again.
VIAGENS.VALIDANDO_CEP: Validating the ZIP codes, this may take a few seconds.
VIAGENS.SEM_MOTORISTA_TITULO: We could not find your driver record.
VIAGENS.SEM_MOTORISTA_TEXTO: Your account has no active driver profile. Ask an administrator or manager to fix your registration.
VIAGENS.CONFIRMAR_TEXTO: Create the trip for {{motorista}} with vehicle {{placa}}?
VIAGENS.AJUDA_LOCAL_FINAL: Pre-filled with the planned destination. Adjust it if the arrival was elsewhere.
VIAGENS.ENCERRADA: This trip is closed. No more actions are available.
VIAGENS.CANCELAR_TEXTO: The trip will be marked as cancelled and the vehicle becomes available again. This cannot be undone.
VIAGENS.EXCLUIR_TEXTO: The trip leaves the list. Anyone with restore permission can bring it back in the "Removed" tab.
VIAGENS.DEFINITIVA_AVISO: A trip can only be erased if all of its incidents are resolved, and the resolved incidents are erased together with it.
VIAGENS.AJUDA_KM_RODADOS: Distance traveled, from 1 to 100,000 km. It is not an odometer reading.

REMOCAO.DEFINITIVA_TEXTO: {{nome}} will be erased from the system forever. This cannot be undone and it cannot be restored later.

ABASTECIMENTOS.SUBTITULO: Follow the fleet refuelings: liters, price and total cost.
ABASTECIMENTOS.VAZIO_TEXTO: When there are refuelings for the chosen filters, they show up here.
ABASTECIMENTOS.SUBTITULO_NOVO: Enter the vehicle, the liters and the price per liter. The total cost is calculated automatically.
ABASTECIMENTOS.AJUDA_MOTORISTA: Only active drivers are listed. If the vehicle is on a trip, use the trip driver.
ABASTECIMENTOS.MOTORISTA_PROPRIO: The refueling will be logged under your name.
ABASTECIMENTOS.ERRO_MAIOR_QUE_ZERO: Enter a value greater than zero.
ABASTECIMENTOS.TOTAL_NOTA: Preview: the final value is calculated automatically (liters x price).
ABASTECIMENTOS.SEM_MOTORISTA_TITULO: We could not find your driver profile.
ABASTECIMENTOS.SEM_MOTORISTA_TEXTO: Your account has no active driver profile. Ask an administrator or manager to fix your registration.
ABASTECIMENTOS.CONFIRMAR_TEXTO: Log a {{litros}} L refueling for vehicle {{placa}}? Estimated total: {{total}}.
ABASTECIMENTOS.EXCLUIR_TEXTO: Delete the {{litros}} L refueling of vehicle {{placa}}? People with restore permission can bring it back in the "Removed" tab.
ABASTECIMENTOS.RESTAURAR_TEXTO: Restore the {{litros}} L refueling of vehicle {{placa}}? It goes back to the active list.

MANUTENCOES.SUBTITULO: Schedule and follow preventive, corrective and inspection services.
MANUTENCOES.VAZIO_TEXTO: When there is maintenance for the chosen filters, it shows up here.
MANUTENCOES.SUBTITULO_NOVA: Choose the vehicle, the type and the service date, and enter the estimated cost.
MANUTENCOES.EFEITO_TEXTO: If the vehicle is available, it automatically becomes "In maintenance" when you schedule.
MANUTENCOES.ERRO_DATA_PASSADA: The date cannot be in the past.
MANUTENCOES.CONFIRMAR_TEXTO: Schedule {{tipo}} maintenance for vehicle {{placa}} on {{data}}, with an estimated cost of {{custo}}?
MANUTENCOES.EFEITO_CONCLUIR: When completed, the vehicle's last-maintenance mileage is updated and it goes back to "Available" if there is no other active maintenance.
MANUTENCOES.CONCLUIR_TEXTO: Complete the {{tipo}} maintenance of vehicle {{placa}}? The mileage is updated and the vehicle is freed if there is no other active maintenance.
MANUTENCOES.EXCLUIR_TEXTO: Delete the {{tipo}} maintenance of vehicle {{placa}}? If it was active and the only one for the vehicle, the vehicle becomes available again.
MANUTENCOES.RESTAURAR_TEXTO: Restore the {{tipo}} maintenance of vehicle {{placa}}? It goes back to the active list.

INCIDENTES.SUBTITULO: Follow accidents, mechanical failures and other fleet occurrences.
INCIDENTES.VAZIO_TEXTO: When there are incidents for the chosen filters, they show up here.
INCIDENTES.SUBTITULO_NOVO: Tell us what happened. The photo or PDF is optional but helps the investigation.
INCIDENTES.AJUDA_VIAGEM: Only trips in progress. Picking one fills in its vehicle and driver, but you can change them.
INCIDENTES.AJUDA_SEM_VIAGEM: No trip in progress right now. The incident can be reported without a trip.
INCIDENTES.AJUDA_MOTORISTA: Driver involved in the incident. Only active drivers are listed.
INCIDENTES.FOTO_ARRASTE: Drag the file here or click to choose
INCIDENTES.FOTO_AJUDA: JPEG, PNG or PDF, up to 10 MB.
INCIDENTES.FOTO_ERRO_TIPO: File type not accepted. Send JPEG, PNG or PDF.
INCIDENTES.FOTO_ERRO_TAMANHO: The file is {{tamanho}} and over the 10 MB limit.
INCIDENTES.FOTO_PREVIA_ALT: Preview of the photo chosen for the incident
INCIDENTES.SEM_MOTORISTA_TITULO: We could not find your driver profile.
INCIDENTES.SEM_MOTORISTA_TEXTO: Your account has no active driver profile. Ask an administrator or manager to fix your registration.
INCIDENTES.CONFIRMAR_TEXTO: Report a {{severidade}} severity incident ({{tipo}}) for vehicle {{placa}}?
INCIDENTES.ABRIR_FOTO: Open the photo in full size (new tab)
INCIDENTES.FOTO_INDISPONIVEL: Could not load the photo. Check that the API is up.
INCIDENTES.SEM_FOTO: This incident was reported without a photo.
INCIDENTES.AJUDA_STATUS: The status only moves forward: reported, under investigation, resolved.
INCIDENTES.RESOLVIDO_AVISO: This incident is already resolved. The status does not move forward anymore.
INCIDENTES.STATUS_CONFIRMAR_TEXTO: Change the incident ({{tipo}}) of vehicle {{placa}} to "{{status}}"? The status only moves forward and cannot go back.
INCIDENTES.EXCLUIR_TEXTO: Delete the incident ({{tipo}}) of vehicle {{placa}}? The photo is kept and people with permission can restore the incident.
INCIDENTES.RESTAURAR_TEXTO: Restore the incident ({{tipo}}) of vehicle {{placa}}? It goes back to the active list.
INCIDENTES.DEFINITIVA_AVISO: The incident photo is also erased from the server.

USUARIOS.SUBTITULO: Accounts with access to the system: roles and status.
USUARIOS.VAZIO_TEXTO: When users are registered, they show up here.
USUARIOS.EXCLUIR_TEXTO: Delete the user {{nome}} ({{email}})? They lose access to the system, but you can restore them later.
USUARIOS.DEFINITIVA_AVISO: It only works if they have no trips, refuelings, maintenance, incidents or driver profile.

USUARIO_FORM.SUBTITULO: The account and, for drivers, the driver profile are created together.
USUARIO_FORM.ERRO_SENHA: The password must have 8 to 15 characters.
USUARIO_FORM.AJUDA_PAPEL: Defines what the person can do in the system.
USUARIO_FORM.ERRO_CNH: The license number must have exactly 11 digits.
USUARIO_FORM.AJUDA_VALIDADE: It cannot be in the past.
USUARIO_FORM.ERRO_VALIDADE_PASSADA: The license expiry cannot be in the past.
USUARIO_FORM.CONFIRMAR_TEXTO: Create the account of {{nome}} ({{email}}) with the role {{papel}}?

USUARIO_EDITAR.SUBTITULO: Only the name and the account status can be edited. The role changes in "Promote role".
USUARIO_EDITAR.CONFIRMAR_TEXTO: Save the changes to the account of {{nome}} ({{email}})?
USUARIO_EDITAR.AJUDA_ATIVO_BLOQUEADO: This account cannot be deactivated (it is an administrator or your own account).

USUARIO_PROMOVER.SUBTITULO: A role can only go up. Demoting is not supported.
USUARIO_PROMOVER.AJUDA: Only roles above the current one appear. The change applies right away.
USUARIO_PROMOVER.SEM_OPCAO: There is no role above the current one to offer.
USUARIO_PROMOVER.CONFIRMAR_TEXTO: Promote {{nome}} from {{atual}} to {{novo}}? The change applies right away and cannot be undone by demoting.

CONFIGURACOES.SUBTITULO: Application information and preferences for this browser.
CONFIGURACOES.AVISO_SEM_API: There are no global settings in the API yet. This page only shows information and appearance.
CONFIGURACOES.TEMA_AJUDA: The choice is saved only in this browser.

PERFIL.TEXTO: The e-mail and the role can only be changed by an administrator.

SENHA.TEXTO: Use 8 to 15 characters. You stay signed in after the change.
SENHA.CONFIRMAR_TEXTO: Replace your account password with the new one?
SENHA.ERRO_DIFERENTE: The confirmation must match the new password.

FROTA.SUBTITULO: Fuel consumption and distance covered by the whole fleet.
FROTA.CONSUMO_SUBTITULO: Liters refueled per km driven on completed trips.
FROTA.CONSUMO_VAZIO: There are no refuelings or completed trips yet.

VEICULO.SUBTITULO: How far the vehicle drove, how much it spent and how many incidents it had.
VEICULO.AJUDA_SELETOR: Choose a vehicle to see its efficiency.
VEICULO.VAZIO_TEXTO: Choose a vehicle above to see its efficiency.
VEICULO.SEM_VIAGENS: This vehicle has no completed trips yet: the numbers stay at zero.

MOTORISTA.SUBTITULO: Trips by status, km driven and incidents of a driver.
MOTORISTA.AJUDA_SELETOR: Choose a driver to see their statistics.
MOTORISTA.VAZIO_TEXTO: Choose a driver above to see their statistics.
MOTORISTA.SEM_VIAGENS: This driver has no trips yet.
MOTORISTA.RESUMO: Bar chart with the trips by status. {{lista}}.

INCIDENTES.SUBTITULO: How many incidents exist at each severity level.
